non_blocking_findings.title: GitHub Actions Node.js deprecation warning
non_blocking_findings.description: Foundation CI #179 completed successfully while warning that actions/checkout@v4 and astral-sh/setup-uv@v5 target deprecated Node.js 20 and are being forced to run on Node.js 24. This is a maintenance item, not a Phase 08 functional blocker.

qa_blocker_revalidation.finding: The previous replacement candidate protected the Order Workspace PaymentIntent and Fulfillment roots but still trusted Organization consistency on other relations traversed and rendered by Dashboard selectors, allowing malformed cross-Organization related records to cross a read boundary.
qa_blocker_revalidation.fix: Commit a42f7dc8ccdc518caf7f577b3fac995aade1de9b adds active-Organization predicates to every relation traversed by Dashboard composition/rendering: Order.customer, PaymentIntent.order, Fulfillment.order, Message.customer, Message.channel, IntegrationDelivery.connection and IntegrationDelivery.endpoint. The filters are applied to summary counts, attention queues, recent Orders, search and Order Workspace composition as applicable.
adversarial_tests: test_attention_queues_reject_cross_organization_order_relations creates active-Organization PaymentIntent/Fulfillment records pointing at an Order from another Organization and requires both queues to exclude them.

test_order_reads_reject_cross_organization_customer_relation creates an active-Organization Order pointing at a Customer from another Organization and requires recent Orders, search and workspace to fail closed.

test_message_attention_rejects_cross_organization_customer_and_channel creates an active-Organization Message tied to a Customer and Channel from another Organization and requires queue and KPI count exclusion.

test_integration_attention_rejects_cross_organization_related_records creates an active-Organization IntegrationDelivery tied to another Organization's Connection and Endpoint and requires queue and KPI count exclusion.
qa_blocker_revalidation.conclusion: The rework addresses P08-QA-SEC-002 at the relation boundaries themselves and validates fail-closed behavior with intentionally inconsistent cross-tenant data. A fresh QA/Security checkpoint remains mandatory and was not executed in this session.

prior_blocker_status.evidence: PaymentIntent and Fulfillment in Order Workspace continue to be selected with active Organization plus the already scoped Order; the original adversarial workspace test remains present and passes in the full candidate suite.

candidate_comparison.material_delta_after_prior_review_carrie: From review carrier 2bbbd7526b10cf3fcb6fe4250610704b3a86651c to the material candidate, only apps/dashboard/selectors.py and apps/dashboard/tests/test_dashboard.py change. read_model_boundaries.summary: Dashboard remains a synchronous read-composition layer over canonical domains with no dashboard-owned lifecycle or persistence.

organization_filters.payment_intents: organization=organization and order__organization=organization; workspace additionally requires order=the scoped Order
organization_filters.fulfillments: organization=organization and order__organization=organization; workspace additionally requires order=the scoped Order
organization_filters.messages: organization=organization, customer__organization=organization and channel__organization=organization; workspace additionally restricts source_type=ORDER and source_id=scoped Order id

attention_queues.summary: Payment, Fulfillment, Messaging and Integration attention queues remain bounded and derived from canonical states. The new predicates strengthen tenant isolation without adding Dashboard-specific workflow rules.
attention_queues.cross_tenant_adversarial_coverage: CONFIRMED for PaymentIntent-Order, Fulfillment-Order, Message-Customer/Channel and IntegrationDelivery-Connection/Endpoint.

workspace_composition.order_scope: Order requires active Organization, Customer in active Organization and requested id.
workspace_composition.payment_scope: PaymentIntent requires active Organization, Order in active Organization and exact scoped Order.
workspace_composition.fulfillment_scope: Fulfillment requires active Organization, Order in active Organization and exact scoped Order.
workspace_composition.message_scope: Messages require active Organization, Customer and Channel in active Organization, ORDER source type and exact scoped Order id.
workspace_composition.cross_tenant_order_behavior: Workspace continues to fail closed with 404 when the Order itself is outside the active Organization.

authorization_and_isolation.authentication: dashboard_home and order_workspace remain decorated with @login_required and @require_GET.
authorization_and_isolation.active_organization: Organization is resolved from active_organization_for_user(user=request.user, session=request.session); Dashboard accepts no arbitrary Organization request identifier.
authorization_and_isolation.relation_isolation: All relations whose objects are traversed or rendered by the current Dashboard selectors now carry an explicit Organization predicate.
authorization_and_isolation.qa_note: This is Independent Review evidence only. QA/Security must independently retest authorization and tenant isolation before GO/NO-GO.

privacy.summary: The rework only narrows selector results. Templates remain limited to operational identifiers, display/snapshot names, statuses, amounts and channel display names. No credential, secret, raw callback payload, complete private contact snapshot or arbitrary provider metadata was introduced.

read_only_and_side_effects.http_contract: Dashboard endpoints remain authenticated GET-only views; POST remains covered as HTTP 405.
read_only_and_side_effects.persistence: apps.dashboard continues to have zero persistence models and no Dashboard migrations.
read_only_and_side_effects.external_effects: The material rework contains selector predicates and tests only. It introduces no provider call, sandbox access, credential handling, public callback, deploy, release, Coolify change or Phase 09 implementation.

performance_and_n_plus_one.analysis: The added Organization checks compile into joins/predicates inside the existing bounded queries rather than per-row fetches. recent_orders retains select_related(customer) and its one-query N+1 regression test. Payment/Fulfillment/Message/Integration queues remain bounded by DASHBOARD_LIMIT where applicable and use select_related for rendered foreign keys.
performance_and_n_plus_one.workspace: Workspace retains a fixed number of queries; stronger predicates do not create a data-size-dependent N+1 pattern.
performance_and_n_plus_one.conclusion: No performance regression rising to a blocking Review finding was identified.
